subject.title: fix(webchat): broadcast agent TTS media final payloads

question: Should this proven but conflicted branch be sponsored for a current-main rebuild, or should the canonical issue remain open for a fresh implementation?
rationale: The patch carries useful unique delivery and history coverage, but substantial owner-boundary refactoring means automation cannot safely choose the conflict resolution or confirm that every invariant still belongs in the same layer.

options.title: Sponsor current-main rebuild
options.body: Port the narrow invariant and focused tests onto current reply-dispatch, media-projection, and transcript owners, then request real WebChat proof.

options.title: Keep issue canonical
options.body: Close or pause this PR only after preserving its unique cases on the canonical issue for a fresh implementation.
